ideas.pitch: An AI-powered academic analytics platform designed for colleges in Kerala that predicts student drop-out risks and suggests personalized interventions using localized grade and attendance patterns.
ideas.title: CampusPulse Academic Risk Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since the hackathon is hosted at Amal College of Advanced Studies, solutions targeting local educational administration and student retention directly appeal to the academic judges.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local agricultural supply chain matching platform that connects rubber and spice farmers directly with regional processors, utilizing real-time price forecasting.
ideas.title: Malabar AgriLink
ideas.why_it_could_win: Nilambur and the surrounding Malabar region have a heavy agricultural economy, making a localized supply chain tool extremely relevant to the local panel of judges.

ideas.pitch: A localized developer collaboration and peer-to-peer micro-mentorship platform integrated with Google Developer Groups resources to foster ongoing tech community building across Kerala campuses.
ideas.title: GDG Nilambur DevCommunity Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the interests of GDG Kozhikode sponsors who value community empowerment, developer tooling, and Google ecosystem integration.

ideas.pitch: An image-recognition web app tailored for college campuses to scan, classify, and track daily waste disposal rates, gamifying recycling efforts among student departments.
ideas.title: EcoAudit Campus Waste Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Sustainability and campus-level operational efficiency are high-priority themes for institutional evaluators looking for practical utility.

ideas.pitch: A multilingual, offline-first symptom triage assistant designed for rural community health workers in Kerala to record preliminary patient data and prioritize critical cases.
ideas.title: HealthScan Local Clinic Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a pressing regional healthcare accessibility challenge with localized utility, resonating strongly with judges looking for real-world impact.
